QuestInfo.name: Baa Baa Baabaalloon
QuestInfo.0: #p9310145# has a gift ready for the Year of the Sheep! Ask #p9310145# how you can get your hands on it!
QuestInfo.1:
Get some #t4001778# items and pay a visit to Baabaalloon Hill.

Event Description: Players everywhere can collect items#k to blow up the Baabaalloon until it pops! #bThe last player to contribute will earn prizes for all the players in their world.
There will be an hour break after round 1 of the event. Hope you all participate!
QuestInfo.2:
Pop the Baabaalloon to get some gifts! But only the world of the player that pops it will get gifts!

Event Description: Players everywhere can collect items#k to blow up the Baabaalloon until it pops! #bThe last player to contribute will earn prizes for all the players in their world.
There will be an hour break after round 1 of the event. Hope you all participate!

0.0: Hello,  #b#h0##k. With the Year of the Sheep upon us, I thought a giant sheep balloon would be the perfect way to celebrate! I'm calling it the Baabaalloon, because something so adorable needs an adorable name! Oh, wait, you should actually come look at it first. Come on over to Baabaalloon Hill! I named that, too!

no.0: I'm telling you, this is the best giant sheep balloon you will EVER see!

yes.0: Oh, if you're coming you should grab a #b#i4001778# #t4001778##k or twenty on the way. Hunt pretty much anything #bbetween 11 levels below you and 21 levels above you#k to find #t4001778# items.
yes.1: Bring me a mess of #t4001778# items at Baabaalloon Hill, and I'll blow up our lovely sheep balloon even bigger! When it pops, I'll be sad, but it'll drop TONS of gifts! The thing is, the gifts are only for the person who pops it. Well, them and #reveryone in that player's world#b. You gotta understand, I'm not made of gifts!
yes.2: You can use the Dimensional Mirror in each town to get to Baabaalloon Hill. Also, it takes about 1 hour to prepare a new balloon. So don't be disappointed if you show up and there's no huge, friendly sheep waiting for you. Just come back a little later!
